scope: Standalone read-only loader build, guarded physical-read entry and callback-based dual-record journal; no boot handoff or Flash mutation adapter.

release.command: cmake -S tests -B artifacts/flashdb-gc-release -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build artifacts/flashdb-gc-release --target ota_physical_read ota_journal ota_ab && ctest --test-dir artifacts/flashdb-gc-release -R '^ota_(ab|journal|physical_read)$' -V --timeout 60

tests.limits: Callbacks and in-memory NOR; prefix erase/program interruption is not physical power-loss qualification. Platform register guards reviewed statically, not executed on a device.

baselines.command: for target in hello ble bringup ui_demo product; do pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/Build.ps1 -Example "$target" -Jobs 4 || exit "$?"; done

candidate_layout.physical_read_guard: Verified startup inhibition, exact NOR metadata, all three alias registers zero and AES off before and after each read.
candidate_layout.known_boot_limit: Official boot leaves identity alias with nonzero range; this prototype conservatively refuses it. RAM unmapping and B execution remain unverified.

failures_and_corrections: Previous thread stopped on usage limit after failed loader builds; existing sources and logs preserved.
Kconfig omitted select custom_mem_map; project map was generated but not selected. Fixed and map ROM geometry checked.
Shared source objects landed in source directories. Moved compilation to official VariantDir and removed only the three exact generated object paths.
Initial guard confused 8 KiB metadata allocation units with 4 KiB NOR erase alignment. Independent review found the permanent-refusal path; corrected and re-reviewed.
Overbroad symbol check rejected vendor RAM-retained Flash write/erase functions; these remain distinct from project mutation entry points.
SDK includes writable FAL shell even without FlashDB; removing FAL alone left regop/pin mutation commands. Final configuration disables the entire interactive shell and rejects any shell export.

independent_review.roles: Two read-only source reviewers; no writes, builds, Git, devices or child delegation.
independent_review.result: Reported alignment and writable-shell blockers fixed; final focused review found no new blocker. Actual model execution metadata not separately exposed.

next_bounded_experiment: Project-owned boot entry and RAM alias transition prototype; resolve inherited identity alias, cache/instruction-fetch, B execution and reset route before freezing formal partitions.
